	rpx_navy_focus_reward = yes
	add_tech_bonus = {
		name = rpx3_ss_design
		bonus = 1
		uses = 1
		category = naval_equipment
	}
}

rpx_navy3_total_fleet_reward = {
	set_country_flag = rpx_navy3_total_fleet
	rpx_navy_focus_reward = yes
	add_to_variable = { rpx_navy_damage_var = 0.10 tooltip = naval_damage_factor_tt }
	add_to_variable = { rpx_navy_defense_var = 0.05 tooltip = naval_defense_factor_tt }
	add_to_variable = { rpx_navy_range_var = 0.05 tooltip = navy_max_range_factor_tt }
	add_to_variable = { rpx_navy_org_var = 0.05 tooltip = navy_org_factor_tt }
	navy_experience = 100
	add_command_power = 300
	add_war_support = 0.15
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}
